Remote Work Policy v2 (2026-08-14). Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week. The remaining days are expected on-site for collaboration. Remote work requests must be approved by the direct manager at least 48 hours in advance. Employees working from a different time zone for more than two consecutive weeks must file a temporary relocation notice with People Ops. The company provides a laptop and one monitor for remote work.

Remote Work Policy v1 (2024-02-01). Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. There is no formal approval requirement for the standard arrangement. The company provides a laptop. Monitors are the employee's responsibility.

Benefits FAQ. On-site employees receive a monthly commuting allowance of 60 dollars. Remote-first employees can convert the commuting allowance into a home-office allowance of the same amount. The wellness stipend is 300 dollars per quarter.
